acceptance: no current-limit latch and waveform stays inside approved U1 Q1 Q2 SOA

stimulus: repeat steady-load rail test at nominal battery voltage
acceptance: 12V is 11.7V to 12.3V below 120mVpp; 3.3V is 3.20V to 3.40V below 50mVpp

stimulus: repeat steady-load rail test at the upper input endpoint
acceptance: 12V is 11.7V to 12.3V below 120mVpp; 3.3V is 3.20V to 3.40V below 50mVpp

stimulus: slowly ramp below the approved UV threshold
measurement: UV trip threshold and restart hysteresis
acceptance: 12V output disables without chatter and measured thresholds match the signed tolerance analysis

stimulus: slowly ramp above the approved OV threshold
acceptance: 12V output disables before component limits are exceeded and recovery follows the approved hysteresis

stimulus: apply reverse input through guarded fixture
acceptance: no 12V output no current-limit escalation and no component overstress

stimulus: apply controlled short at J3 through the guarded fixture
measurement: U3 current limit fault and recovery
acceptance: branch limits safely MOTOR_ENABLE_SAFE remains low and restart follows the approved latch policy

stimulus: step Jetson branch between 10 percent and 90 percent of approved load
acceptance: no controller reset or UVLO event and rails recover inside the supplier-approved settling envelope

stimulus: power cycle from fully discharged state
acceptance: 12V_ISO then JETSON_12V then 3V3_LOGIC separated by at least 10ms

stimulus: open both E-stop channels during active request
acceptance: MOTOR_ENABLE_SAFE removed within 1ms and reset remains latched while request is asserted

stimulus: open each E-stop channel separately and inject welded-contact discrepancy
measurement: channel independence discrepancy latch and reset inhibit
acceptance: MOTOR_ENABLE_SAFE stays low and manual reset is rejected until both channels agree

stimulus: run dual-endpoint loop with selectable termination
acceptance: zero error frames for 10min and dominant recessive levels stay inside approved transceiver limits

acceptance: no rail exceeds the approved clamp window or any component absolute maximum

stimulus: operate for 4h with the production enclosure closed
measurement: converter Jetson MOSFET shunt connector and harness temperatures
acceptance: Jetson below 80C converters below 110C and every approved component below its derated limit

stimulus: exercise all populated interfaces and fixture-access-plan rows
measurement: J4 GPIO SPI I2C UART plus J10 J11 and critical fixture nets
acceptance: all levels continuity polarity and fault semantics match controlled interface data
